items.claim: Alexander Poppik is making his heavyweight debut after fighting at middleweight and light heavyweight previously.
items.quote: Poppik is literally like not a heavyweight. Making his heavyweight debut, he's fought, you know, at middleweight in multiple fights, light heavyweight, of course, as of recent.

items.claim: Jovon Leica will have a 40 to 50 pound weight advantage over Alexander Poppik.
items.quote: this guy Leica might have, you know, 40 to maybe even 50 pounds on, you know, Poppik.

items.claim: Boris Lav Nicolich has a massive height and reach advantage.
items.quote: He's gonna have a massive height and reach advantage in this fight.

items.claim: Mark Velogden has taken a ton of damage and taken years off his life in his last two fights.
items.quote: this guy has taken like years off his life in these last two fights getting hurt a ton, eating a ton of, you know, big shots.

items.claim: Boris Lav Nicolich has a ton of power and an opportunistic submission game.
items.quote: Nicolich, he's going to make you pay. If you're hitable, he's going to make you pay. He has a ton of power, a very opportunistic submission game.
